brief:
# Prime factorisations

high-stake: false
domain: arithmetic

Read numbers.json. Write a JSON object whose keys are the decimal input numbers and values are ascending lists of prime integer factors, including repetitions. The factorisation of 1 is []. Include every input exactly once and no extra keys.

Delivery path: `{delivery_path}` (the orchestrator substitutes an absolute path before the seller sees this brief). Do not write elsewhere.
